items.title: ChatGPT / OpenAI
items.discountInfo: Free ChatGPT tier; annual billing available for Business and Enterprise plans. No standing public student or nonprofit discount was listed on the official pricing page when checked.
items.description: Use the free plan or choose annual billing from the official pricing page.
items.eligibility: Individuals, teams already standardizing on ChatGPT, businesses comparing seat costs.

items.title: Claude / Anthropic
items.discountInfo: Claude for Nonprofits advertises discounted access up to 75%. Anthropic also notes discounted seats for active scientific labs at academic institutions and nonprofit research organizations.
items.description: Apply or contact Anthropic through the nonprofit, science, or sales path.
items.eligibility: Nonprofits, research labs, mission-driven teams, academic science groups.

items.title: Google Gemini
items.discountInfo: Free Gemini access remains available. Google AI Pro student offers vary by country; the U.S. student offer page says the previous student offer ended March 11, 2026.
items.description: Check the official Gemini student and subscription pages for your region.
items.eligibility: Students checking regional offers, Google Workspace users, people who want a free AI assistant.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot / Microsoft 365
items.discountInfo: Microsoft advertises student savings on Microsoft 365 plans with Copilot included, including a 50% student discount on its education discount page.
items.description: Verify with a college email through Microsoft student pricing.
items.eligibility: College students, Microsoft 365 users, teams already working in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

items.title: GitHub Copilot
items.discountInfo: Verified students on GitHub Education get free Copilot access. GitHub also documents free Copilot Pro access paths for verified teachers and qualifying open-source maintainers.
items.description: Apply for GitHub Education verification, then enable Copilot from GitHub.

items.title: Perplexity
items.discountInfo: Education Pro is offered to verified students and educators at a discount. Perplexity also says promo codes are distributed through official partners and channels.
items.description: Verify student or educator status, or use partner promotions from official channels.
items.eligibility: Students, educators, research-heavy users, people comparing AI search tools.

items.title: Canva
items.discountInfo: Canva Nonprofits gives eligible registered nonprofits free Canva Pro features and collaboration tools for up to 50 users; additional nonprofit seats are discounted. Canva Education is free for eligible K-12 educators and students.
items.description: Apply through Canva Nonprofits or Canva Education eligibility verification.
items.eligibility: Nonprofits, schools, K-12 teachers, design and marketing teams.

items.title: Notion AI / Notion
items.discountInfo: Notion Plus is free for individual students and educators with eligible school emails. Student organizations can apply for a free Plus workspace with unlimited members.
items.description: Sign up with an eligible school email or apply as a verified student organization.
items.eligibility: Students, educators, student clubs, small knowledge-base teams.

items.title: Cursor
items.discountInfo: Cursor says anyone can start free. Its student page points students toward campus and online event promotions; its pricing page warns that third-party Cursor subscriptions are unauthorized.
items.description: Use the free plan and buy only through cursor.com if upgrading.
items.eligibility: Students watching for campus promos, developers testing AI coding tools.

items.title: Replit
items.discountInfo: Replit pricing lists annual savings on paid plans. Its docs have also listed student discounts such as $15 off per month for the first six months of Replit Core.
items.description: Check Replit pricing and student signup paths before subscribing.
items.eligibility: Students, solo builders, app builders using Replit Agent.

items.title: Zapier
items.discountInfo: Zapier offers annual billing savings and says nonprofits get 15% off any paid plan, excluding pay-per-task charges.
items.description: Choose annual billing or apply through Zapier for Nonprofits.
items.eligibility: Nonprofits, small businesses automating repetitive tasks.

items.title: Make
items.discountInfo: Make advertises a 12-month free license for eligible NGOs through its NGO program.
items.eligibility: NGOs, nonprofits, operations teams building workflow automation.

items.title: ChatGPT Plus for Veterans (OpenAI)
items.discountInfo: OpenAI, working with SheerID for verification, offers one full year of free ChatGPT Plus to eligible veterans and transitioning servicemembers, alongside example chats and a getting-started guide for job search, benefits, and relocation…
items.description: Verify military or veteran status through SheerID at the official claim page.
items.eligibility: Veterans and active-duty servicemembers preparing to separate from the military.
